verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs describe a `cognee-cli report` that writes a 'Graph Insight Report' summarizing what a dataset's graph contains, plus `.improve` which enriches the knowledge graph with new relationships/concepts after ingestion, and auto-routed `recall()` that surfaces the best-matching information — all evidence of AI-generated insight/enrichment from stored data. However this is closer to knowledge-graph enrichment and reporting than a dedicated 'insights and suggestions' feature aimed at end users, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of insight quality. Missing for 10: a first-party or independent example of proactive suggestion generation (not just retrieval/enrichment), and outside validation that the Graph Insight Report/suggestions are genuinely useful.
